tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart's appVersion when empty.

port.description: Port the wuFlow application listens on.

secureCookie.description: Set the Secure flag on session cookies. Disable only for non-HTTPS setups.

remoteIpHeader.description: HTTP header with the client's IP address, set by the ingress controller. wuFlow uses it only if the direct peer is a trusted proxy (trustedProxies); the client is the rightmost entry that isn't a trusted proxy. Use CF-Connecting-IP behind the Cloudflare proxy. Empty = all users share the ingress controller's IP and thus one login rate limit.

trustedProxies.description: Comma-separated CIDRs or IPs of the proxies whose remoteIpHeader is trusted. Empty = app default: loopback and the private ranges, which include the usual pod networks. No effect if remoteIpHeader is empty.

initialAdminEmail.description: Email address for the initial admin account created on first install.

existingSecret.description: Name of an already existing Secret to use instead of letting the chart generate one. Leave empty to have the chart create and manage the Secret itself.

initialAdminPassword.description: Key name for the initial admin password inside an existing Secret. Defaults to initial-admin-password.

secretKey.description: Key name for the secret key (JWT and session token signing) inside an existing Secret. Defaults to secret-key.

host.description: Hostname the ingress should route to wuFlow, e.g. wuflow.example.com. Must be set by the deployer, no default is provided.

annotations.description: Extra annotations added to the ingress resource.

secretName.description: TLS secret name. Leave empty to use the ingress controller's default certificate.

compress.description: Create a Traefik compress Middleware and attach it to the ingress router, so responses are sent compressed. Requires ingress.className "traefik" (helm fails otherwise) and Traefik's Kubernetes CRDs (traefik.io/v1alpha1).

storageClass.description: StorageClass used for the persistent volume claim. Adjust to your cluster's storage class (e.g. standard, longhorn).

size.description: Size of the persistent volume, e.g. 1Gi.

hostUsers.description: Set to false to run the pod in its own Linux user namespace (container UIDs map to unprivileged, pod-unique UIDs on the node). Requires Kubernetes 1.33+ and node support (Linux kernel 6.3+, containerd 2.x or CRI-O, runc 1.2+ or crun); pods fail to start on nodes without it.

ephemeral-storage.description: Requested ephemeral storage (container logs and the /tmp emptyDir), e.g. 64Mi.
Ephemeral storage limit, e.g. 256Mi. Covers the container logs (~50Mi with the kubelet's default log rotation) and the /tmp emptyDir (max 64Mi); exceeding it evicts the pod.
